messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P1 alert fired for private-control-plane (rule: vpc-connectivity-loss) — customer: acme-finance-vpc. Trigger: heartbeat missing from on-prem agent for >5m. Pager ID: PD-87432. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

pagerduty: Notification: Incident PD-87432 created and notified oncall group.

alice (oncall): ack — I'm taking this. Starting triage. @carla can you confirm whether acme reported anything on their side?

carla (customer-success): Not from them yet, I pinged the SE. They said they saw app errors around 10:12 UTC and a recent config push earlier today. Waiting on reply.

alice (oncall): thanks. first-pass checklist: 1) check control plane health 2) check on-prem agent heartbeats 3) check customer VPC route table and firewall logs 4) open bridge if we need it.

ben (sre): I'm pulling the control plane metrics now. Control plane nodes in us-west-2 show increased API error rate and kubelet reconnects.

alice (oncall): running remote diagnostics against agent.
```bash
# check agent heartbeat timestamp
curl -sS https://private-controlplane.internal/api/agents/acme-agent-07 | jq '.last_heartbeat'
# expected: recent timestamp
```

ben (sre): got logs from control plane: several TLS handshake timeouts to 10.0.5.0/24 (customer VPC peer). Example logs: 
```
2026-01-27T10:14:21Z controlplane-1 error: failed handshake to 10.0.5.12: TLS timeout
2026-01-27T10:15:03Z controlplane-2 warn: connection reset by peer
```

alice (oncall): ssh attempt to on-prem agent IP 10.0.5.12 fails (no route). traceroute shows packet loss after our egress GW.

alice (oncall): @dave can you confirm whether any recent network changes to the private control plane egress rules?

dave (eng-runtime): I deployed the new NAT rule set at 09:50 UTC for cleanup, but only applied to staging. Prod changelog shows no changes. Checking infra audit now.

carla (customer-success): Update from customer SE: they saw their firewall team applied a deny rule for a CIDR that includes our agent IPs around 10:10 UTC to 10:20 UTC while rolling out IDS signatures. They are rolling back now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation reminder in 2m (PD-87432).

alice (oncall): good find. @carla ask them to confirm rollback completion and to run connectivity test from their VPC to agent IPs. Meanwhile I'll attempt to re-establish control-plane connections and flip fallback routing.

ben (sre): enabling fallback route to route-controlplane-backup for acme-vpc. Applied BGP override for prefix 10.0.5.0/24 -> controlplane-backup-gw.

alice (oncall): applying quick restart of agent acceptor on controlplane nodes to drain stuck handshakes.
```bash
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/controlplane-acceptor
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=controlplane-acceptor -o wide
```

alice (oncall): controlplane-acceptor pods restarted, readiness probes green. Attempting heartbeat check again.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded for PD-87432 by alice (oncall). Escalation suspended.

carla (customer-success): Customer reports rollback complete at 10:28 UTC and a successful ping to 10.0.5.12. They also included a firewall rule ID they reverted: fw-2331.

alice (oncall): Confirmed agent heartbeat returned: last_heartbeat: 2026-01-27T10:28:41Z. Control plane metrics returning to baseline.

ben (sre): I see KV cache warmups and reduced error rate. No more TLS timeouts.

carla (customer-success): Customer still saw a brief spike in 5xx errors for their app during the window. They're asking for a post-incident summary and RCA.

alice (oncall): Created incident ticket INC-20260127-042 with timeline and mitigation steps. Adding @dave for deeper RCA since we had a fallback route applied.

dave (eng-runtime): will investigate whether our egress detection could have proactively flagged the CIDR deny. Possible improvement: alert on SYN/RST rate and BGP path changes for customer VPCs.

alice (oncall): bridge opened: https://meet.internal/incident/INC-20260127-042 — adding logs and runbook links. Runbook used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-vpc-connectivity.md

incident-bot: Reminder: please follow oncall handoff protocol if you leave: post status, next steps, and ETA for next responder.

alice (oncall): I'm handing off in 30m — system stable, customer confirmed rollback and heartbeats. Next: dave to analyze RCA, ben to monitor metrics for 2h. I'll update incident ticket with immediate timeline and handoff notes.

oncall-next: ack — I'll pick up monitoring at 11:00 UTC and keep the bridge open.

carla (customer-success): Thanks team. I'll coordinate the customer-facing postmortem and sync with SE to confirm no residual config changes.

alice (oncall): incident status -> mitigated. PD alert resolved. Closing Slack thread and moving follow-ups to INC-20260127-042. :white_check_mark:
